entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Dr. Maruki's supposed to[n]contact us today... right?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Before that happens, there's[n]something I want to tell you.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Do you have any time today?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Preferably somewhere we[n]can relax and chat...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Sorry for all the trouble. Hope to[n]hear from you soon.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It seemed like she wanted to talk to you[n]earlier this morning too, so maybe you[n]should hear her out...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, what's it going to be? Do you want to[n]go see Sumire?

entries.en: I should be able to deepen[n]our bond since I have [clr 1][var 5][clr 27][n]of the [var 2] arcana...
